options.name: --site
options.description: The site to import into, by slug or id; the default site when left out.

options.description: The content types to import, separated by commas; every type of the package when left out. With --url, a key with transfer.manage in the site only names the types it may import: an export has a file for every global type, empty or not, and importing one needs transfer.manage for the instance.
